notablePrerequisites:
Fool's Demise attached to Palinchron.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Palinchron, adding one mana of any color.
Fool's Demise's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Palinchron from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning Fool's Demise to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Fool's Demise by paying {4}{U}, targeting Palinchron.
Repeat.
If the seven lands can tap to produce at least {4}{U}, this combo nets infinite colored mana.
